sources.group: A. Chemistry, visualization and chemical information
sources.integration: USER-INSTALLED HOST + JSON-RPC; optional approved libraries
features: Structure opening/saving with CJSON and supported files
Geometry optimization with supported force fields
Molecular surfaces and orbitals from computed inputs
Existing supported Python/C++ plugins kept in native host
sources.caveat: RPC / plugin versions must be tested in real host. CJSON is Avogadro-oriented native data, not universal. Do not promise all legacy plugins load unchanged.

sources.group: A. Chemistry, visualization and chemical information
sources.integration: EMBED REACT 2D EDITOR + typed API
features: Undo/redo, auto layout and canvas navigation
SMILES, SDF, CML and other formats where available
sources.caveat: Version-pin React, Ketcher and service mode. Indigo remote mode optional; some operations not identical in browser standalone.

sources.group: A. Chemistry, visualization and chemical information
sources.integration: ISOLATED PYTHON ENGINE, checked tool API
features: Descriptors (e.g., logP and polar surface area)
Fragment/query and reaction transformations where validated
Property table calculation and bulk processing
sources.caveat: Stereochemistry/atom properties/3D and tags may be lost during conversion. A descriptor is not a validated clinical/toxicity prediction.

sources.group: A. Chemistry, visualization and chemical information
sources.integration: OPTIONAL VERSION-PINNED HOST/CLI ADAPTER
features: Conversion between supported molecular model files
sources.caveat: License per shipped version and linking/distribution approach must be reviewed; cannot automatically treat as permissively bundlable.

sources.group: B. General research data and numerical tools
sources.integration: ISOLATED PYTHON DATA ENGINE
features: Unit-aware structured table interface built by us
Preserve raw inputs and data provenance
sources.caveat: We must implement own unit/schema metadata; do not silently coerce units or erase original row identifiers.

sources.group: B. General research data and numerical tools
sources.integration: ISOLATED SCIENTIFIC CALCULATION ENGINE
sources.caveat: Numerical validity, units, noise model and uncertainty calculations require explicit tests; fit alone does not prove mechanism.

sources.group: B. General research data and numerical tools
sources.integration: EMBED PLOTLY INTERACTIVE VIEW; EXPORT MATPLOTLIB STATIC
features: Linked selections between plots/tables where supported
sources.caveat: Need consistent style and provenance, not screenshots as only scientific output.

sources.group: B. General research data and numerical tools
sources.integration: OPEN ORIGINAL NOTEBOOK / OPTIONAL JUPYTER SERVER BRIDGE
features: Python cell execution in isolated environment
Reproduce datasets, parameter configurations and figures
Allow experts to continue their existing kernels and workflows
Optional notebook-agent parity via typed tools
sources.caveat: Do not execute untrusted notebooks automatically; embedding a full Jupyter server is not mandatory for v0.1.

sources.group: B. General research data and numerical tools
sources.integration: FORMAT IMPORTER + PROVENANCE AND RIGHTS LAYER
features: Kinetic model and experimental result linking
ORD reaction metadata / conditions and outcomes
sources.caveat: Standards/data repositories, not simulation engines. Do not confuse ORD reaction yield with enzyme mechanism ground truth. Dataset rights need review.

sources.group: C. Kinetics, atomistic and quantum simulation
sources.kind: Open-source native host and Python interface
sources.integration: OPTIONAL PYTHON BASICO ENGINE; NATIVE COPASI ORIGINAL FILES
sources.caveat: Licensing/compatibility must be version-pinned. Computational models require fitted/known parameters.

sources.group: C. Kinetics, atomistic and quantum simulation
sources.integration: OPTIONAL ISOLATED PYTHON ENGINE / EXTERNAL CALCULATOR PLUGINS
features: Atomic energies, forces and stresses via chosen calculators
sources.caveat: ASE is an interface to calculators, not proof that a requested engine or method is installed or accurate.

sources.group: C. Kinetics, atomistic and quantum simulation
sources.integration: OPTIONAL PYTHON QUANTUM ENGINE
features: Property calculations where method supports them
sources.caveat: Quantum results depend on method/basis/convergence, should be labeled computed model not measured truth.

sources.group: C. Kinetics, atomistic and quantum simulation
sources.integration: OPTIONAL ISOLATED MOLECULAR DYNAMICS ENGINE
sources.caveat: GPU, force fields, substantial dependencies and validated molecule parameterization remain separate installation/science gates.

sources.integration: OPTIONAL PYTHON CRYSTAL ENGINE
features: Calculated XRD patterns and unit annotations
Phase/property plots where input data justify them
sources.caveat: CIF lossy serialization and symmetry tolerances need benchmarks. Calculated XRD is theoretical, not a measured spectrum.

sources.integration: OPTIONAL PYTHON/C++ STRUCTURAL DATA ADAPTER
sources.caveat: CIF and macromolecular mmCIF are different use cases; do not drop chain or experiment metadata by flattening into SMILES.

sources.kind: Proprietary, free under restrictive vendor license
sources.integration: REFERENCE_ONLY; INDEPENDENT FEATURES VIA PYMATGEN/SPGLIB
sources.caveat: No redistribution of its binaries without written consent. No direct host integration rights assumed.

sources.integration: REFERENCE_ONLY; INDEPENDENT CIF CRYSTAL VIEWER
sources.caveat: Free community features not same as paid CSD portfolio; redistribution and commercial use not cleared.

sources.integration: OPTIONAL PYTHON PROTEIN/SEQUENCE ADAPTER
features: Link sequence identifiers to rendered structures
sources.caveat: Independent structural annotations must retain source IDs; not a mechanism-of-action inference system.

sources.integration: REFERENCE_ONLY; ORIGINAL PROTEIN/LIGAND VIEWER AND CONTACT REPORT
sources.caveat: Its branded assets and proprietary binaries not included; geometry contacts do not establish binding affinity or clinical activity.

sources.integration: REFERENCE_ONLY; OPTIONAL USER-INSTALLED EXTENSION IF RIGHTS CLEARED
features: Original third-party extensions under proper terms
sources.caveat: Noncommercial academic/research grant and separate commercial license. Core cannot be copied or bundled without permission; original extensions may be separate works.

sources.integration: DOCUMENTED FEATURE REFERENCE; DO NOT REUSE CODE/BINARY
sources.caveat: No reengineering/decompilation or redistribution under vendor terms; verify abstract feature requirements with independent science.

sources.integration: REFERENCE_ONLY; SCIENTIFIC PYTHON SPECTRUM STUDIO
sources.caveat: Free noncommercial license not free for commercial R&D; no vendor binary integration approved.

sources.integration: OPTIONAL PYTHON MASS-SPECTROMETRY ENGINE
sources.caveat: Requires instrument data, careful parameterization and domain QA. Not the same as optical spectroscopy.

sources.integration: USER-INSTALLED NATIVE HOST / PYIMAGEJ BRIDGE
features: Existing Fiji plugins preserved in original host
sources.caveat: Plugins execute in original Fiji host. Cannot promise they work unchanged in a new embedded process.

sources.kind: Open-source scientific image GUI with plugins
sources.integration: OPTIONAL NATIVE HOST OR PYTHON BRIDGE
sources.caveat: Different GUI/Qt process; preserve original plugins rather than transpiling them into our React app.

sources.integration: OPTIONAL NATIVE HOST PYTHON CONSOLE/MACRO BRIDGE
sources.caveat: CAD is adjacent to chemistry but separate domain and data model; not initial shipping promise.

sources.integration: OPTIONAL NATIVE HOST / PYQGIS PROCESSING BRIDGE
sources.caveat: Not chemistry first; map formats, CRS and plugin ABI independent of molecular engine.

sources.integration: REFERENCE_ONLY; DESIGN ORIGINAL KETCHER-BASED EDITOR UX
sources.caveat: Free standalone license does not authorize embedding into our product; obtain written rights for any vendor host API use.

sources.integration: LEGACY REFERENCE ONLY
sources.caveat: Discontinued for new users in 2026; no bundle or new-user install plan.

sources.kind: GPL DataWarrior host; AI agent repo licensing needs audit
sources.integration: BENCHMARK; USER-INSTALLED HOST ADAPTER ONLY AFTER GPL REVIEW
features: Natural-language macro tool calls via Ollama
sources.caveat: Existing local-agent competitor. Agent repository has no confirmed redistributable license; do not copy code. Test via native app only if permitted.

sources.integration: BENCHMARK + POSSIBLE INTEGRATION AFTER LICENSE AUDIT
sources.caveat: Direct competitor, not evidence our stack is first. Prefer comparing metrics or collaborating over blindly forking.

sources.kind: Published 1.4 source AGPL; newer binary rights different
sources.integration: BENCHMARK; NO COPYING WITHOUT AGPL COMPLIANCE
sources.caveat: Existing desktop competitor; version-specific source licensing, local-model compatibility and true offline operation need testing.

sources.integration: BENCHMARK ONLY; OPTIONAL HOST IF VENDOR API RIGHTS
sources.caveat: Do not assume its AI runs locally or its components can be redistributed.

sources.product: KNIME Analytics Platform and AI extensions
sources.integration: BENCHMARK; NO DIRECT UI/CODE CLONE
features: Integration with Python and local LLM nodes
sources.caveat: Mature incumbent and UI inspiration. Platform user count does not imply AI feature uptake; license every extension separately.

sources.group: J. Local model and extensibility layer
sources.kind: Open-weight model candidates / open tool runtimes
sources.integration: LOCAL MODEL RUNNER; explicit optional download
features: Ask clarifying questions when variables absent
User-specific optional LoRA adapters after validation
sources.caveat: No trained model exists yet. Existing small Qwen weights are not proven reliable on full workflows; model add-on size cap separate from RAM/app size.

sources.group: J. Local model and extensibility layer
sources.product: Python SDK / CLI / MCP / community plugins
sources.integration: TYPED VERSIONED TOOL REGISTRY
features: Invoke scientific tools by user-defined names
Tool parameter schemas and error reporting
Action history, undo where feasible and deterministic replay
Community plugin discovery and compatibility metadata
Integration with independent coding agents as optional clients
sources.caveat: Only approved/sandboxed plugin execution; not unrestricted tools and no claim existing plugin binaries are portable across hosts.
